mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that lower seizure threshold and may reduce primidone efficacy; primidone induces metabolism of foscarnet metabolites and increases CNS toxicity risk.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium) regularly, maintain seizure control parameters, and consider alternative antiviral therapy if possible; adjust primidone dosing based on seizure control and drug levels.
